sentences.en: Their stay in Germany for a year was very fruitful.
sentences.zh: 他们在德国一年的学习收获很大。

sentences.en: She went to Germany for the purpose of studying music.
sentences.zh: 她去德国是为了学习音乐。

sentences.en: If you ironed Switzerland, it would be bigger than Germany.
sentences.zh: 如果你把瑞士熨平，它的面积会比德国大。
